2023_075_dec_2022_pcard_report.paragraph: Troy School District's purchasing-card (PCARD) transaction report for December 2022, printed 2/9/2023 and carried to the Board of Education meeting of February 14, 2023, lists every card charge and credit by transaction date, merchant, journal-entry description ("DEC PCARD EXP"), budget unit and account (A/C) code. The listing runs 30 pages and closes with a subtotal of 291,070.18 in transaction amounts against 5,341.45 in credits, for Total Expenses of 285,728.73. The single largest charge is 8,983.48 to B&H PHOTO on 12/19/2022 against budget unit 101071127573100, object 6410.

**Funds and account codes used**
Budget units span general-fund instructional and operational lines, grant units, special-education units, community and early-childhood units and student-activity units, with numbers such as 101013111100100, 120315125684600, 122885214314000, 529202229660000, 530212351701000, 531004118000000, 700070399708000 and 701013199697100. Object codes appearing on the register include 3120, 3180, 3190, 3210, 3220, 3430, 3450, 3510, 4110, 4120, 4130, 4220, 5000, 5110, 5310, 5410, 5610, 5710, 5910, 5990, 6410, 6460, 7410 and 7910. Student-activity budget units are almost uniformly coded 5000; general-fund instructional lines are dominated by 5110.

**Spending patterns**
Amazon-family merchants (AMZN MKTP US, AMAZON.COM with varying suffixes, AMZ*AMAZON.C) account for the largest share of individual line items, most in the tens of dollars. Athletic-equipment purchasing is concentrated in a single 12/20/2022 BSN SPORTS posting run spread across budget units 101970293907000, 101970293908000, 101970293909000, 101970293910000, 101970293912000, 101970293915000, 101970293917000 and 101970293000000. A recurring pattern of identically priced charges split evenly across a dozen elementary budget units (101005111042500 through 101017111042500) appears for AMAZON.COM*H at 9.98/9.99, STAPLS760271 at 12.31/12.32, AMAZON.COM*7 at 22.00/22.01 and AMAZON.COM*E at 17.47/17.48. Travel and conference charges cluster under 101425221042600 (object 3220) with DELTA airfare at 197.20 repeated, HAMPTON INNS at 521.32 repeated and TEACHERS COL at 850.00 repeated.
